title: Choose a value with the ternary operator

blocks.text: The ternary operator `condition ? a : b` is a shorthand for an `if`/`else` that chooses between two values: `(age >= 18) ? "Adult" : "Minor"`.

items: `max(int a, int b, int c)` returns the largest of three values: `max(5, 3, 1)`, `max(1, 5, 3)` and `max(3, 1, 5)` are all `5`, and `max(5, 5, 5)` is `5`.
`status(int age)` returns `"Adult"` from `18` up and `"Minor"` below it: `status(20)` is `"Adult"`, `status(18)` is `"Adult"`, `status(17)` is `"Minor"`.

blocks.text: Every `int` is allowed, negative ones included.

cases.says: The largest of three values, and an adult or a minor.
max(-5, -3, -9) is -3: the maximum does not start from 0.

concepts: The ternary operator ?: chooses between two values in one expression.
